Your door team scans tickets on their own phones and fastens the right wristband on each guest. Walk-ups buy at the door, and you see who has arrived as the night goes on.

Ticket sales and revenue update live, with a report for each part of your sales that you can share with your partners. You find out which sites send you visitors, plan around your venue's weather and export your orders.
You can pay artists, suppliers and crew from your ticket money as it arrives, give your team cards with limits, and collect deposits and invoices into the same balance.
Your site is ready before the gates open. You map your site, hire lists come from riders, deliveries book into arrival times and kit goes out and back by scan.
One live control log covers your site, you see the pass holders in each zone and official weather warnings for your venue, and medical care, barriers and permits stay on track.

Outside India, each resale carries a 10% resale fee. The seller gets the ticket price back in full, and the fee is charged separately to their original card. Your event page can tell sellers about it.

You can share live sales with a co-promoter or sponsor through a link, without adding them to your event. You can export the orders behind any figure to a spreadsheet.
